title: RecoveryRecord v1 decrypted logical payload (modeling view)
description: Authenticated advisory recovery metadata. It is not AccountControlState authority. Frozen wire/encryption constructions remain governed by CDDL/registries/ADR-0141.

record_generation.description: Monotonic per RecoveryStore scope/record lineage; lower than the durable client high-water mark is stale.

recovery_epoch.description: Observed recovery epoch; authenticated metadata, not authority.

last_known_acs_head.description: Last authenticated ACS head known to the writer; used for rollback/partition detection only.

provider_metadata_snapshot.description: Potentially stale provider routes/capabilities/descriptors; revalidate before reuse.

relationship_snapshot.description: Normal-profile recovered relationship metadata; potentially stale and revalidated.

relationship_snapshot_ciphertext.description: Maximum-Privacy second-layer relationship snapshot encrypted under an independent RelationshipRecoveryKey.
